partners.mechanism_chain: PCK1 (HGNC:8722) —DISRUPTS→ Gluconeogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-150034); Gluconeogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-150034) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoglycemia (HP:0002146); NT5C2 (HGNC:29705) —DISRUPTS→ Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-1435256); Glycolysis (REACT:R-HSA-1435256) —DECREASES→ ATP (CHEBI:15422); ATP (CHEBI:15422) —LEADS_TO→ Spastic paraplegia (HP:0002510); Gluconeogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-150034) —DECREASES→ ATP (CHEBI:15422); ATP (CHEBI:15422) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoglycemia (HP:0002146). Loss-of-function mutations in PCK1 impair gluconeogenesis, leading to hypoglycemia. Loss-of-function mutations in NT5C2 impair nucleotide metabolism and indirectly impact glycolysis, potentially reducing ATP production. The convergence is on cellular energy state (ATP levels) and the metabolic pathways themselves.
